answer: By the pearl of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The lagoon holds work receipts rather than names, so the jade of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, every claim is re-checked by someone with nothing to gain. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name.
